channel.title: DFP Cleaner
channel.description: Updates for DFP Cleaner, from DF Productions.

item.title: Version 2.4
item.description:
DFP Cleaner 2.4

Settings now has both update switches, in a new Updates section: whether the app checks for updates, and whether it installs them by itself.

  • Check for updates automatically. DFP Cleaner looks for a new version once a day while it's open, and never while it's closed. It's on, as before. Turn it off and the app makes no connection by itself; DFP Cleaner > Check for Updates… still works whenever you choose it.
  • Install updates automatically. It's off: each update shows its window with what's new and waits for you to click Install Update. Turn it on and updates download and install by themselves. The checkbox at the bottom of the update window and the one in Settings are the same switch, so you can change it in either place, and turn it off again in Settings.
  • Reset to Defaults turns the check on and automatic installs off.

item.title: Version 2.3
item.description:
DFP Cleaner 2.3

iPhone photos no longer grow when they're cleaned. A HEIC photo is now cleaned the way JPEG and PNG photos are: the hidden details are taken out and the picture itself is copied exactly as it was. The clean copy is a little smaller than the original, where it used to come out at more than twice the size.

  • HDR photos stay HDR. The extra brightness an iPhone stores for HDR screens is kept.
  • The rotation, the color profile and the small preview picture stay.
  • Portrait photos keep their look. The blurred background stays as it was taken, but the Portrait effect can no longer be changed on an iPhone afterwards: the depth information that makes that possible is taken out too.
  • What's taken out: the camera and lens, the date and time, the location, Apple's own camera notes, editing history, a Portrait photo's depth information, and the Photographic Style settings.
  • A HEIC built in a way DFP Cleaner can't clean in place is re-encoded as before, and its row says so and why.

item.title: Version 2.2
item.description:
DFP Cleaner 2.2

DFP Cleaner can now update itself. Once a day it checks whether there's a new version. When there is, a window shows what's new, and Install Update downloads it, replaces the app and opens the new one. You can also choose DFP Cleaner > Check for Updates… at any time, or pick Later or Skip This Version.

  • Every update is checked before it's installed. It must carry DF Productions' signature, or it's refused.
  • Nothing about your Mac or your files is sent. The check only fetches the list of versions, and then the update itself.
  • The About box says © 2026 DF Productions, LLC.

This version still comes from Drew. From here on, new versions arrive by themselves.
